note: One record per attempt of a run. A measurement that was not taken is null, never 0. The run's metrics.json keeps its own shape; this file is written beside it.

fields.schema_version: the version of this record format
fields.unit: the logical unit the attempt belongs to
fields.attempt: the attempt's number within its unit, from 1
fields.harness: the agent harness the attempt ran on (claude, codex or pi)
fields.provider: the model the attempt ran on, or null when the run named none
fields.source_revision: the commit the attempt reported, or null when it reported none
fields.finished_at: when the attempt ended (ISO 8601), or null while it runs
fields.elapsed_seconds: the seconds between the two, or null when one of them is missing
fields.outcome: the attempt's final status (COMPLETE, RELEASED, BLOCKED, ...)
fields.verified: true when the completion was verified, false when it was not, null while it is unknown
fields.counters: tool_calls, model_calls, tool_loops, retries, interventions and human_rescues; a count that was not measured is null
fields.tokens: the input, output and cached token figures, labelled; a figure nobody reported is null
fields.gates: the gates the attempt went through and how each ended
fields.checks: the attempt's own checks, with their outcomes
